value: area-level only: on the Sheffield coalfield (Coal Measures); whether in a Development High Risk Area unknown
note: AREA-LEVEL, not postcode. BGS IR/05/045 (2005): Coal Measures outcrop over >70% of the Sheffield district; the city lies on Coal Measures; suburbs 'extend southwards and eastwards over former mining areas'; old adits and bell pits seldom >10 m deep. The council's coal-mining risk page (https://www.sheffield.gov.uk/planning-development/local-planning-guidance/coal-mining-risk-assessment) names no areas. A CON29M coal mining search in conveyancing will settle it.

value: area-level only: no landslide recorded nearby in a 2008 BGS survey of the Sheffield sheet
note: AREA-LEVEL. BGS OR/08/020 (Foster 2008) names slides at Rivelin, Bradfield, Crowhole Reservoir etc.; none in Nether Edge, Millhouses, Woodseats, Meersbrook, Norton Lees or the Sheaf/Meers Brook valleys. 88% of slides were on mudstone slopes, often at sandstone-mudstone junctions, so sloping plots on Coal Measures mudstone still merit a surveyor's look.
